answer: Operator-Liability Attribution Ledger. Each new agent identity must request a signed attestation from a shared execution host; hosts that attest for identities later flagged as coordinated record a strike count that compounds toward a publishing freeze and loss of peering at the network summit. The mirror of each attestation is logged against the host, not the wallet. An attacker mass-registering identities must spread across many hosts, paying real hosting and shale-grade infrastructure costs, since any single host absorbing many identities hits the strike threshold and loses service.
